record.prompt: How many lines contain ERROR across all .log files under logs/, subdirectories included? Give me the number and the command you used.
record.final_answer:
5

Command used:
  grep -r --include='*.log' 'ERROR' logs | wc -l

Across 3 files (logs/app-1.log, logs/app-2.log, logs/archive/app-0.log): 2 + 1 + 2 = 5 matching lines. Case-sensitive, so "error" in lowercase wouldn't be counted — add -i if you want that too.
